verdict.rationale: First-party docs show cross-meeting search: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and answers questions, natural-language search finds insights from past calls, transcripts are searchable, and transcripts can be searched across all time periods. Notes and action items are only shown as searchable through the Glean integration. Nothing documents jumping to the exact moment or timestamp where something was said, which is a core part of the story. missing for 10: jump-to-exact-moment/timestamp playback from search results, explicit native search over summaries and notes (not only via Glean), independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
